entries.name: Guava ListenableFuture only
entries.author: Google
entries.description: Contains Guava's com.google.common.util.concurrent.ListenableFuture class, without any of its other classes -- but is also available in a second "version" that omits the class to avoid conflicts with the copy in Guava itself. The idea is: - If users want only ListenableFuture, they depend on listenablefuture-1.0. - If users want all of Guava, they depend on guava, which, as of Guava 27.0, depends on listenablefuture-9999.0-empty-to-avoid-conflict-with-guava.
